senses.gloss: maunīndra, adj. (to Skt. munīndra plus -a), of the prince(s) of sages: ˚draṃ (pra)vacanaṃ Divy 〔490.14, 16〕.

mauneya, nt. (once in RV.; = Pali moneyya), sage-hood, state of being a muni: muni pravyāhara dharmaṃ ˚yaṃ uttamaṃ padaṃ Mv 〔iii.387.2〕, sage-hood, (which is) the highest station; ˚yaṃ ca pṛcchasi nāla duḥkaraṃ … [] 4 (these vss = Pali Sn 〔700, 701〕); evaṃ ˚yaṃ (em., but this word supported by corresp. vs in Pali Sn 〔716〕) upeṣyasi 〔388.14〕.
